content.thinking: Hmm — "Command exceeded 180 seconds" — the BASH tool killed it at 180s? The bash tool seems to have its own 180s limit... Actually the exception says command exceeded 180 seconds and returncode 0? Odd. Anyway — I need to run long dev commands with nohup/background and poll. content.text: The bash tool has its own time cap. Let me run long dev tests in the background and poll:

arguments.command: cd /workspace && (nohup timeout 1500 python3 tmp/scale.py > tmp/scale.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 2; echo started
